runs.finding: The coordinator routed the coverage worker partly by the PCA keyword and over-assigned empirical-research.md.
runs.correction: Added an explicit decision-over-keyword rule to the parent and delegation contract.

runs.finding: Independent decisions were separated, executed concurrently, kept within worker module boundaries, and reconciled by the parent.
The downstream worker did not exist until the upstream artifact had completed, and it confirmed receiving that artifact verbatim.

runs.reason: The collaboration thread limit was reached after the diagnostic, corrected parallel, and staged trials. The case remains statically specified and structurally validated but is not claimed as live evidence.

limitations: These are small, single-run behavioral trials rather than production-frequency measurements.
Exact model-token or billing usage was not exposed, so no token-savings claim is made.
Workers read the governing parent SKILL.md in addition to their assigned module because skill-use instructions require it.
The single-module no-spawn case was not executed live because the collaboration thread limit was reached.

A separate post-edit council turn could not start for the same thread-limit reason; the fresh coordinators and their specialist workers provide behavioral evidence, while deterministic validators provide the final file-level check.
